FAQ

Questions answered. Doubts cleared.

How soon will I see ranking results?+
SEO compounds over time. Most clients see initial keyword movement in 60–90 days and meaningful traffic growth within 4–6 months. We set clear milestone targets from Day 1 so there are never surprises.
What exactly is AEO, GEO and LLM SEO?+
AEO optimises for Google AI Overviews, Featured Snippets and PAA boxes. GEO ensures your brand is cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and SGE. LLM SEO structures your authority so AI models recommend you — proven with Weavings Manpower, now ranked #1 on ChatGPT.
Why is there a 6-month minimum commitment?+
SEO needs time to compound. Six months is the minimum for results that genuinely last — clients who stay longer see exponentially better ROI on every rupee invested.
Are prices inclusive of GST?+
No — all listed prices are exclusive of GST (18%), added to the final invoice as per Government of India regulations.
How does annual billing work?+
Annual billing saves ₹2,000 per month on any plan — ₹24,000 saved per year. Toggle between Monthly and Annual above the plans to see your exact savings.
Do you work with businesses outside Mumbai?+
Yes — headquartered in Mumbai but we serve clients across India and internationally. Fully remote-friendly with dedicated account management throughout.
